organizerViewFields.issues[].subjectEventIds?: 当前 uid/update 下非 candidate 的真实事件成员 ID，去重；只读展示，不能作为写入授权
organizerViewFields.events[].duplicateEvidenceCount?: 当前 uid/update/event 下 evidenceRole=duplicate 的来源记录数；不包含 supporting/discarded

imports.parseFile.isolation: a failed file parse changes only that import file and never rolls back or mutates sibling files

imports.getFile.rowPolicy: Each source row appears once in cursor order; parsed rows do not create draft events or old per-row decisions.

financeUpdates.post.categoryPolicy: category_assignment 为可选建议；缺分类不阻止整批入账，其他核对和服务端完整性校验仍必须通过。正式 category_id 保留 NULL。

rules.identity: uid and WeChat OpenID are server-only; identity-shaped client fields are rejected recursively
rules.upload: the server issues an opaque user-scoped cloudPath and parse only accepts the exact registered object path
rules.money: source decimal text is converted to minor-unit decimal strings without JavaScript floating point
rules.evidence: files, per-file parse batches, FinanceUpdate, Evidence, EconomicEvent, Relation, ReviewIssue, FinanceAction and formal Transaction remain separate; issue.subject.primaryEvidence includes masked original paymentMethod and optional source status for account confirmation
rules.parseUpgrade: same unposted file bytes reuse a batch only for an equal parse-run-v2 fingerprint; changed parser or interpretation versions append a batch and preserve prior evidence. A core interpretation change may reuse an identity only with the same file digest, source locator, identity anchor digest and unchanged amount/currency/direction; conflicts from other file bytes remain blocked
rules.organization: same amount, nearby time or similar text creates candidates only; only a stable shared reference plus compatible core fields may auto-merge evidence
rules.postability: ready is server-derived after planning, every issue resolution and inside the posting transaction; clients cannot submit ready
rules.posting: one FinanceUpdate commits all ready formal transactions and evidence links in one MySQL transaction; one aggregate repayment EconomicEvent may project to multiple formal transfers only when positive unique liability-account allocations exactly conserve the event amount; any failure rolls the whole update back
rules.cashBalance: atomic posting may not create or deepen a negative cash balance; failure rolls back accounts, mappings, transactions, links and state together
rules.prePostingWriteBarrier: before financeUpdates.post, account creation and reusable mapping changes remain FinanceUpdate-scoped drafts; abandoning or a failed post leaves formal accounts, mappings, transactions, balances and reports unchanged
rules.paymentRules: recognized atomic payment methods may map to one account or be permanently ignored per user and source; an aggregate statement reference such as Alipay 花呗｜信用购 is never an account or reusable mapping and must be allocated to real liability accounts; temporary ignore never silently becomes a permanent rule
rules.lifecycle: Files and parse batches preserve source evidence. Replacing or abandoning an unposted FinanceUpdate atomically removes its derived events, evidence links, relations, review issues/members and account/mapping drafts, while retaining update/source summaries and action audit. Formal accounts, transactions, reusable mappings and source identities are unchanged. Storage-object cleanup remains best-effort.
rules.publicWritePath: The only posting implementation is financeUpdates.post. Legacy single-file services and their decision/posting/link tables are removed by migration 0012.
rules.idempotentReplay: Mutation keys and request digests remain durable. Receipts store small values or current FinanceUpdate/ReviewIssue references; duplicate requests never rerun the action. View replay returns current committed state. A retired issue returns issue=null and empty members; an abandoned update returns empty events/issues and coverage=null.
